entry.title: CSXXL 1.0.13
entry.summary: ## CSXXL 1.0.13 Tested on the Force. **Q-Links and faders follow each other**, like in the other L'Cronx plugins: - Turn a Q-Link and the fader of that page moves. - Touch a fader on screen and its Q-Link name and value follow. - Done per control, no page redraw, nothing polled, cheap on CPU. **Ribbon on FILTER works on every patch**: it moves the cutoff you actually hear. entry.title: CSXXL 1.0.12
entry.summary: ## CSXXL 1.0.12 A two-layer (A/B), 8-voice, polyphonic synthesizer for the Akai Force and MPC OS, in the spirit of the Yamaha CS-80. A completely new build, not a port: the voices are written from Deckard's Dream voice notes and self-built schematics, emulated in code.
